directorStatement.audienceFeeling: The audience feels real-space mischief rushing around a still center: Keen’s cleverness and Fuzzby’s laughter cross the Buzzing Nook distance, but Zenny’s composed leaf quietly measures the cost until the empty machine tells on Keen.
directorStatement.emotionalChange: Zenny is the emotional measuring stick. Keen owns the story change, but the camera keeps asking: how much chaos can pass through Zenny’s peace before she grants it a look? Her final wink is the scene’s quiet victory.
directorStatement.theLaugh: Movement against stillness, then delayed slapback. Keen and Fuzzby generate speed; Zenny absorbs it. The empty catapult becomes the consequence Keen thought he had escaped.
directorStatement.visualSurprise: The approved S1.SH1 wide keyframe: Keen and loaded catapult on the near bank foreground, Zenny distant on her established leaf, Fuzzby asleep on the whole hanging honeycomb at the far tree. -> Zenny on the original leaf with the residual berry mark, eyes closed after one clear wink, peaceful again while the broken machine and returned comb remain consequences elsewhere in the same geography.
directorStatement.carryForward: Warm comic calm: Zenny has seen everything and returned to peace, while the berry mark, returned honeycomb and collapsed empty catapult keep the consequence visible.

northStar.surfaceStory: Keen fires a blueberry at the honeycomb, splats Zenny instead, then steals the whole comb while Fuzzby is laughing; the empty catapult punishes Keen and returns the prize to Fuzzby as Zenny calmly reclaims the scene.
northStar.universalTruth: Other people can be pulled into our private mischief, and sometimes the kindest, funniest answer is not a lecture but a look that says, “I saw all of that.”
northStar.childClearWant: Keen wants to get the honeycomb with his clever machine and not get caught.
northStar.emotionalNeed: Keen needs the world to show him that cleverness does not erase consequences, while Zenny needs to keep her peace without pretending chaos did not happen.
northStar.falseBeliefUnderPressure: If Keen is quick enough and funny enough, the mess belongs to the machine, not to him.
northStar.relationshipEngine: Keen’s over-careful scheming creates the accident; Fuzzby’s delighted laughter gives Keen the tempting opening; Zenny’s stillness turns both boys’ chaos into a readable joke without scolding them.
northStar.ordinaryLifeTruth: A child’s prank often feels private until it lands on someone else; the adult in the room may choose restraint, but they still noticed everything.
northStar.sceneTurn: The turn is not the berry splat alone; it is Keen doubling down after Zenny absorbs the first consequence, then the empty catapult physically answers him.
audienceJourney: See Keen’s careful plan and anticipate a neat honeycomb hit.
Enjoy the blueberry flight across real creek distance.
Laugh at the wrong-target splat because Zenny is so composed.
Feel Fuzzby’s laughter tempt Keen into worse trouble.
Track one clean chase and one clean catapult-tail cause.
Enjoy Keen trying to save dignity just as the machine gives him away.
Land with Zenny’s knowing wink and quiet reset, not a moral.
northStar.finalAfterFeeling: Warm comic calm: the scene stays mischievous, but the berry mark and broken machine keep the cost visible.
northStar.dialogueSubtractionOpportunity: Do not add any line explaining the misfire, the theft, Zenny’s patience, Fuzzby’s pursuit, or Keen’s embarrassment. The empty cup, berry mark, tail snag, rolling comb, listener reactions, machine collapse and final wink carry those ideas.
northStar.environmentPressure: The creek distance prevents cheating the geography; Zenny’s leaf is a still obstacle Keen must pass without touching; the removable hanging honeycomb is both Fuzzby’s perch and Keen’s prize; the still-tensioned empty catapult cord becomes the world’s delayed slapback.

transformation.entryBelief: If I build the clever machine and aim carefully, I can control the outcome and stay hidden from blame.
transformation.entryFeeling: Proud, over-focused, secretly thrilled by his own cleverness.
transformation.pressureBehaviour: He hides after the splat, then uses Fuzzby’s distraction to grab the whole comb instead of stopping.
transformation.costlyChoice: He chooses the opportunistic grab after the first consequence has already landed on Zenny, risking exposure rather than accepting the failed shot.
transformation.exitBelief: Maybe it still counts if I can make it sound almost successful.
transformation.exitAction: He tries to save face with “It almost worked” while the damaged empty catapult tips and collapses beside him.

tapestry.physicalMotif: One loaded-to-empty machine: berry launched, cup empty, cord still tensioned, tail snag, collapse. The prop tracks Keen’s belief in control becoming visible consequence.
tapestry.sonicMotif: A soft woodland bed with a single blueberry WHOOSH/SPLAT, Fuzzby’s authorised laughter under Zenny’s line, frantic wing buzz during pursuit, one tail-slap “Ow!” beat, then a gentle mechanical tip for the final button.
tapestry.colourAndLightProgression: Fresh morning greens and honey-gold start playful; the blueberry mark adds a small comic stain to Zenny’s calm palette; the ending returns to soft morning light but keeps the mark and broken machine as traces.
tapestry.thematicVisualContrast: Movement against stillness: Keen’s machine-and-chase energy and Fuzzby’s buzzing pursuit orbit Zenny’s quiet leaf, making her restraint the comic measuring stick.
tapestry.openingClosingRhyme: Open on the wide Buzzing Nook geography with Keen aiming across the creek at a perfect target; close on Zenny on the same original leaf, marked but peaceful, now knowingly owning the chaos instead of merely receiving it.

creativeIntent.governingAudienceExperience: The audience feels real-space mischief rushing around a still center: Keen’s cleverness and Fuzzby’s laughter cross the Buzzing Nook distance, but Zenny’s composed leaf quietly measures the cost until the empty machine tells on Keen.
creativeIntent.scenePurpose: Open the episode with real-space mischief rushing around Zenny's stillness, letting Keen's empty machine become the delayed consequence of his own cleverness.
creativeIntent.emotionalPointOfView: Zenny is the emotional measuring stick. Keen owns the story change, but the camera keeps asking: how much chaos can pass through Zenny’s peace before she grants it a look? Her final wink is the scene’s quiet victory.
creativeIntent.comicOrDramaticMechanism: Movement against stillness, then delayed slapback. Keen and Fuzzby generate speed; Zenny absorbs it. The empty catapult becomes the consequence Keen thought he had escaped.
creativeIntent.characterPerformanceStrategy: Keen plays over-careful confidence turning into opportunistic panic, then embarrassed dignity. Zenny plays active restraint: eye twitch, attention, lick, settle, later one knowing wink. Fuzzby plays exuberant laughter first, then fast offended pursuit, then satisfied ownership of the returned comb.
creativeIntent.visualGrammar: Wide geography first, then experiential travel through depth. The frame is allowed to leave Keen behind when the berry flies; later it reorients for clarity before the grab and tail snag. Zenny’s leaf is never cheated closer or moved.
creativeIntent.cameraCharacterRelationship: The camera follows the blueberry for delight, then respects Zenny’s stillness by holding long enough for restraint to read. In S1.SH2 it cuts deliberately to a new angle to let Keen’s route past Zenny and the empty catapult cause read cleanly.
creativeIntent.movementVersusStillness: Keen’s launch, grab and recoil are sharp bursts; Fuzzby’s wings stay alive and irregular; Zenny’s small controlled actions become funnier because everything else is overcommitted.
creativeIntent.depthAndEnvironment: The creek distance is story pressure. Near bank machine, far bank leaf, far tree honeycomb and return path remain fixed world anchors. The honeycomb travels as a whole object; the empty cup and tensioned cord remain visible proof of cause.
creativeIntent.rhythmAndEscalation: Launch and splat happen quickly; Zenny’s line gets protected breathing space under tapering Fuzzby laughter. S1.SH2 accelerates through grab and pursuit, lands one clear tail-contact gag, then slows for two dignity lines and the final Zenny hold.
creativeIntent.cutPhilosophy: Two production clips only: S1.SH1 plays the misfire and restraint; S1.SH2 begins with a planned same-moment cut to new readable geography, not a continuous motion relay. Internal view changes are motivated by new information: flight, grab path, contact cause, speaker ownership, final judgement.
creativeIntent.openingImage: The approved S1.SH1 wide keyframe: Keen and loaded catapult on the near bank foreground, Zenny distant on her established leaf, Fuzzby asleep on the whole hanging honeycomb at the far tree.
creativeIntent.closingImage: Zenny on the original leaf with the residual berry mark, eyes closed after one clear wink, peaceful again while the broken machine and returned comb remain consequences elsewhere in the same geography.
creativeIntent.handoverToNextScene: Warm comic calm: Zenny has seen everything and returned to peace, while the berry mark, returned honeycomb and collapsed empty catapult keep the consequence visible.
creativeIntent.intendedFinalFeeling: Warm, splashy relief with the ache still visible in the rain and the soggy crown.

emotion.pressure: A blueberry hits her forehead and Fuzzby's laughter turns the accident into a public joke.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She chooses active composure rather than scolding or pretending not to notice.
emotion.exitState: Marked but settled, with her calm intact and her awareness sharpened.

comedy.mechanism: Movement against stillness with wrong-target reversal.
comedy.setup: Keen aims carefully at the honeycomb from across the creek.
comedy.expectation: The clever machine will send the blueberry into the honeycomb.
comedy.disruption: The berry crosses the real distance and splats Zenny once on the forehead instead.
comedy.button: Zenny calmly says, “OK, Fuzzby, calm down. It’s not that funny.” while Fuzzby keeps laughing underneath.
comedy.hold: Hold long enough after the splat and line for her restraint to be funnier than the impact.

comedy.mechanism: Delayed slapback from the empty machine.
comedy.setup: Keen's launched catapult is empty but still tensioned, and he believes he can use the distraction to steal the whole comb.
comedy.expectation: The problem is Fuzzby catching him during the chase.
comedy.disruption: The real punishment comes from the empty catapult he built, snagging his tail as he passes too close.
comedy.button: Keen's “Ow!” lands on one clean tail contact, and the whole comb rolls to Fuzzby.

physicalStaging.payoffShape: Escape line collapses into one sharp tail snap, then the prize rolls away from Keen to Fuzzby.

emotion.entryState: Still marked on her original leaf, aware of the offscreen aftermath.
emotion.pressure: The chase and machine collapse have proved the chaos did not end with the splat.
emotion.choiceOrRealisation: She chooses one small knowing wink instead of more speech or scolding.
emotion.exitState: Peaceful again, eyes closed, with the residual mark still present.
emotion.observableEvidence: Attention turns toward the aftermath, then toward camera; one clear wink; both eyes close; still hold resumes.

comedy.mechanism: Hiding failure plus deadpan final judgement.
comedy.setup: Fuzzby has the comb and can see Keen beside the damaged empty machine.
comedy.expectation: Keen might recover dignity with a small excuse.
comedy.disruption: The machine tips/collapses after his line, proving the excuse is flimsy.
comedy.button: Zenny's single wink quietly confirms she saw the whole chain.
comedy.hold: Protect the silence after the wink so the scene ends on composure, not another gag.

shots.purpose: Play the misfire, wrong-target splat, Fuzzby's laughter and Zenny's composed restraint as one complete first gag arc.
shots.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: Keen Keen lines up the loaded catapult from the near bank, commits to the release, then immediately drops low beside the empty cup as the berry leaves him behind; action: ENVIRONMENT The oversized blueberry travels across the creek and makes one direct forehead contact, creating one visible splat and residual berry mark on Zenny; reaction: Fuzzby Fuzzby wakes on the whole hanging comb and laughs with chest, head, wings and antennae all bouncing in uneven bursts while remaining supported by the comb; settle: Zenny Zenny opens her eyes, registers Fuzzby, licks away juice with measured control, then returns to a still seated pose with the berry mark still visible. Cause and effect: One release empties the catapult cup; the berry’s flight ends in one forehead splat on Zenny; the impact and Fuzzby’s laughter draw Zenny out of meditation, but her controlled cleanup restores stillness without removing the mark. Visible turn: The visible change is from Keen’s careful confidence to hiding, and from Zenny’s meditation to marked awareness, then back to chosen composure. Land on: End held on Zenny on her original leaf, calm again with the residual berry mark; Fuzzby remains on the whole hanging comb; Keen stays offscreen by the empty machine with empty paws. Acting freedom: Allow small variations in Keen’s duck, Fuzzby’s laugh rhythm, wing flutter and Zenny’s micro-blinks, provided there is only one launch, one splat, no grab, and Zenny’s recovery stays restrained.

shots.purpose: Complete the opportunistic grab, chase, tail-snag slapback, social aftermath and final Zenny wink in the second requested production clip.
shots.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: Keen Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank; action: Fuzzby When the comb is removed, Fuzzby drops from the lost perch, catches himself with fast irregular wings, fixes on Keen and pursues across the same route; reaction: Keen Keen glances back, tightens into panic, passes too close to the empty catapult, recoils from one tail contact, and loses the comb as it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby; settle: Zenny After the near-bank aftermath and soft machine collapse, Zenny turns from the offscreen result toward camera, gives one clear wink, closes both eyes and resumes meditation on the original leaf. Cause and effect: Keen’s removal of the whole comb takes away Fuzzby’s support, causing Fuzzby to catch himself and pursue. Keen’s return path brings his tail into the still-tensioned empty arm or cord; one release snaps his tail, his recoil releases the comb, and the comb’s weight carries it through a bounce and roll to Fuzzby. The damaged empty machine later tips down softly after the exchange. Visible turn: Keen visibly shifts from sneaky opportunity to chased panic to embarrassed dignity; Fuzzby shifts from displaced pursuit to satisfied possession; Zenny shifts from watchful stillness to a single knowing acknowledgement. Land on: End on Zenny alone on the original leaf, residual berry mark matched from S1.SH1, both eyes closed after one wink; near-bank consequences remain true offscreen: Fuzzby has the whole comb and Keen is beside the collapsed empty machine. Acting freedom: Allow chase cadence, wing jitter, comb bounce spacing, Keen’s recovery posture and listener micro-reactions to vary, but preserve clear Zenny clearance, whole-comb ownership, empty-cup visibility, one tail contact, one machine collapse and one final wink.

performanceContractApproved.playableIntention: Keen wants to turn distraction into victory, then preserve dignity after the machine exposes him; Fuzzby wants the comb back and then enjoys the returned prize; Zenny waits until the chaos has spent itself before giving one controlled acknowledgement.

phases.observableAction: Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank.
When the comb is removed, Fuzzby drops from the lost perch, catches himself with fast irregular wings, fixes on Keen and pursues across the same route.
Keen glances back, tightens into panic, passes too close to the empty catapult, recoils from one tail contact, and loses the comb as it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby.
After the near-bank aftermath and soft machine collapse, Zenny turns from the offscreen result toward camera, gives one clear wink, closes both eyes and resumes meditation on the original leaf.

shots.seedancePrompt:
[Audience Purpose]
Story beat: Keen tiptoes past Zenny, removes the whole comb, proves the branch empty, and triggers Fuzzby’s wing-buzz pursuit handoff.
Audience before: The audience reads Fuzzby laughing, Keen calculating, and the creek route as a clear opportunity.
Audience after: The audience reads a clean theft, a visibly empty branch, and Fuzzby immediately converting loss into pursuit.

[One-Sentence Summary]
Show Keen’s opportunistic tiptoe across the creek, the whole honeycomb coming away intact, and Fuzzby losing support into pursuit.

[ACTION OWNERSHIP]
Keen is the sole actor who removes the comb.
Fuzzby is the sole character who loses support and begins the pursuit.
Zenny remains a still witness whenever visible.

[Camera Consciousness]
Dramatic owner: Keen.
Emotional action: He notices opportunity and begins a sneaky, guilty commit across the creek.
Camera state: controlled.
Viewpoint: Cross-bank opening from the near bank, slightly low, so Keen’s route and Zenny’s fixed witness position read in the same geography.

watchDirectorFeedbackHistory.old:
Julian authorises locking these visual refinements and firing ONE new full 26-second S1.SH2 take. Retake source: S1.SH2-b5-20260910T123301-fb2d125e. Preserve the approved opening keyframe, all seven current image references and their actual upload roles, and the exact approved HEAR WAV. No audio generation, audio edits, dialogue retiming or new words. Keep the existing Seedance non-dialogue SFX, ambience and instrumental music policy. Exact dialogue stays Keen 8.00–9.24 Uh-oh—, Keen 12.00–13.40 Ow!, Fuzzby 18.00–19.56 Nice machine., Keen 20.00–22.20 It almost worked. Preserve each existing Audio1 provider block verbatim.
Correct the character swap through clear current per-view roles. Zenny @图3 is the smaller bee with small dark nose, lashes, rosy cheeks, glasses and residual berry mark; she stays on her original leaf. Fuzzby @图4 is the larger plump bee with bulbous tan nose, wire spectacles and wings; he is the pursuer and comb receiver. Keen @图5 is the upright blue bear with gold cuffs. Do not change identity; do permit the explicitly directed movement and honeycomb transfers. No global ownership/position freeze. Both bees keep their own canonical wings and faces. Update the source coverage, Director Card, acting and animation directions together; do not append another competing story.
Keep six timed views: 0–2.5, 2.5–6, 6–10, 10–15, 15–23.4, 23.4–26. In view 2 Zenny is a static distant witness only if visible. In views 3–5 the visible cast is Keen and Fuzzby ONLY; remove Zenny and her leaf from those views' visible/critical entity lists, keeping her continuity offscreen. View 6 is Zenny alone, leaf and nearby foliage only. Source view IDs remain V01,V02,V03,V04,V05,V07. Preserve the source world-space route and approved action lifecycle: one comb visibly detached, branch remains empty, comb carried back and rolled to Fuzzby on near-bank ground. He never resets to the tree. One tail contact and one collapse only, after the final line. Keen never moves on all fours.
Use the following concise typed visual direction for each view. Keep the full internal history and state records in Studio; the final shared execution compiler must emit a compact prompt, without copying state dumps or repeated character bibles.

View 1:
Camera: Static wide; begin exactly on @图1.
Action: Keen notices his miss, then chooses to steal the honeycomb while Fuzzby laughs atop it. Zenny stays still on her distant leaf.
Performance: Keen's jaw closes; his eyes find opportunity before he moves.
Setting: Preserve creek distance, warm morning light and plush 3D CGI materials.
End state: Keen beside upright empty catapult; Fuzzby on hanging comb; Zenny on leaf.

View 2:
Camera: Track Keen full-body toward the far tree, then settle on his paws and the comb attachment.
Action: Keen tiptoes on two feet past Zenny with clear space, then takes the whole comb by 5.5s. Show the comb detaching, entirely in his paws, and the empty branch. Only then Fuzzby loses support, drops and catches himself with his wings.
Performance: Keen checks, commits. Fuzzby's surprise becomes offended pursuit.
Setting: Zenny is only a static distant witness if visible.
End state: Keen carries the intact comb; Fuzzby is airborne; branch empty.

View 3:
Camera: Track the return crossing laterally; stop at the near-bank catapult.
Action: Keen runs on two feet with the comb; Fuzzby pursues in drone-like flight. Keen plants both feet by 7.8s, stationary through 8.00–9.24s. After speaking he backs toward the machine; no contact yet.
Performance: Keen glances back, eyes widening; short legs stay proportionate. Fuzzby fixes on Keen, wings buzzing.
Setting: Preserve creek direction; machine upright and empty.
End state: Keen stopped with comb; Fuzzby closing.

View 4:
Camera: Side/contact view: tail, live cord/arm, empty cup, comb and receiving ground readable.
Action: At 11.75s Keen's tail catches the live cord/arm. One release at 12s causes one tail slap, recoil and comb release. The whole comb bounces once, rolls once, reaching Fuzzby by 14.6s.
Performance: Keen jolts with the pain cue; Fuzzby tracks the comb and settles on it.
Setting: Comb size unchanged; machine stays upright and empty.
End state: Fuzzby on the landed comb; Keen recovering, both near-bank.

View 5:
Camera: Continuous near-bank two-shot; gently reframe between Fuzzby and Keen, preserving eyelines.
Action: Fuzzby addresses Keen from the landed comb. Keen answers beside the empty upright machine. After his answer, the catapult collapses once softly at 22.25–23.25s.
Performance: Fuzzby underplays his appraisal. Keen gathers embarrassed dignity, then his shoulders sink. Listeners stay closed-mouth.
Setting: Keep the comb grounded here; nobody returns to the tree.
End state: Fuzzby retains the comb beside Keen and the collapsed empty machine.

View 6:
Camera: Fixed medium close-up of Zenny alone on her original leaf.
Action: Zenny looks toward camera. At 24.35s one eye closes in a clear wink while the other stays visibly open. At 24.6s she gives a warm closed-mouth smile. Both eyes close by 25.15s; meditate until 26s.
Performance: A deliberate wink, not a two-eye blink; amused, never speaking.
Setting: Match berry mark/light; surround Zenny with leaf and soft foliage.
End state: Zenny alone, mouth closed, eyes shut; berry mark visible.

performanceContractApproved.playableIntention: Keen wants to turn distraction into victory, then preserve dignity after the machine exposes him; Fuzzby wants the comb back and then enjoys the returned prize; Zenny waits until the chaos has spent itself before giving one controlled acknowledgement.

phases.observableAction: Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank.
When the comb is removed, Fuzzby drops from the lost perch, catches himself with fast irregular wings, fixes on Keen and pursues across the same route.
Keen glances back, tightens into panic, passes too close to the empty catapult, recoils from one tail contact, and loses the comb as it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby.
After the near-bank aftermath and soft machine collapse, Zenny turns from the offscreen result toward camera, gives one clear wink, closes both eyes and resumes meditation on the original leaf.

performanceContractApproved.physicalCauseAndEffect: Keen’s removal of the whole comb takes away Fuzzby’s support, causing Fuzzby to catch himself and pursue. Keen’s return path brings his tail into the still-tensioned empty arm or cord; one release snaps his tail, his recoil releases the comb, and the comb’s weight carries it through a bounce and roll to Fuzzby. The damaged empty machine later tips down softly after the exchange.
performanceContractApproved.visibleEmotionalTurn: Keen visibly shifts from sneaky opportunity to chased panic to embarrassed dignity; Fuzzby shifts from displaced pursuit to satisfied possession; Zenny shifts from watchful stillness to a single knowing acknowledgement.
performanceContractApproved.requiredLanding: End on Zenny alone on the original leaf, residual berry mark matched from S1.SH1, both eyes closed after one wink; near-bank consequences remain true offscreen: Fuzzby has the whole comb and Keen is beside the collapsed empty machine.
performanceContractApproved.performanceFreedom: Allow chase cadence, wing jitter, comb bounce spacing, Keen’s recovery posture and listener micro-reactions to vary, but preserve clear Zenny clearance, whole-comb ownership, empty-cup visibility, one tail contact, one machine collapse and one final wink.

phases.observableAction: Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank.

source.scope: Official Dreamina/BytePlus prompt guidance; executable API schema, pricing and account access are separate

guideSemantics.timestampControl: Time ranges allocate pacing and exact time points improve alignment; they are not a frame-accurate edit guarantee.
guideSemantics.extensionPreservation: Preserve the source and match its boundary state, but review the join; generated continuation and boundary frames are not guaranteed pixel-identical.
guideSemantics.negativeInstructions: Explicit forbidden items improve reliability but remain probabilistic and require review.
guideSemantics.identityStability: Multi-character consistency is improved, not self-approving; identity and count still require visual review.
guideSemantics.longVideoRoute: The 5-180 second mode is a Dreamina beta product capability, not a qualified Studio API route.
guideSemantics.audioOnly: Dreamina product guidance describes audio-only creation; the current BytePlus Seedance 2.0 API still requires at least one image or video reference.
guideSemantics.cleanOutput: Dreamina advertises cleaner 4K output; the executable provider contract remains the authority for resolution and every render still requires QC.
guideSemantics.watermarkPolicy: The Studio never uses generative watermark removal as a production shortcut; source footage must be owned or licensed and delivered clean.

storyIntentApproved.narrativeFunction: Keen's private plan visibly affects Zenny and creates the distracted Fuzzby opening for the next unit.
storyIntentApproved.secondaryAudienceFeeling: Warm appreciation for Zenny's controlled patience.
storyIntentApproved.outerAction: Keen launches one berry; it splats Zenny; Fuzzby laughs; Zenny speaks and settles.
storyIntentApproved.innerAction: Zenny decides not to give chaos the satisfaction of a big reaction.
storyIntentApproved.performanceDirection: Play Zenny's restraint as active attention and controlled choice, not blank calm; play Fuzzby's laughter as delighted overflow, not mockery with malice.
storyIntentApproved.mutedRead: Without sound, the audience understands the aim, launch, wrong impact, empty cup, Zenny's mark, Fuzzby's laughter and Zenny's calm reset.
storyIntentApproved.environmentPressure: The creek distance makes the miss feel consequential and prevents the gag from becoming a cramped prop trick.
storyIntentApproved.soundStory: Woodland ambience supports space; one whoosh and splat mark the action; Fuzzby's authorized laughter continues under Zenny's line and tapers below the words.
storyIntentApproved.motifUse: The machine motif begins as loaded control and immediately becomes an empty consequence.
storyIntentApproved.thoughtChangeAndCut: Zenny's thought changes from meditation to noticing to choosing calm; the cut after the hold moves us to Keen exploiting that calm.
storyIntentApproved.mustUnderstand: One berry only, one splat only, Zenny remains on her original leaf, Fuzzby remains on the whole comb, catapult cup is empty.
storyIntentApproved.mustNotKnowYet: No grab, chase or tail punishment happens in this unit.
storyIntentApproved.reactionBeat: Zenny's small controlled reaction changes the gag from simple impact to character comedy.
storyIntentApproved.relationshipDistance: Keen is physically distant/offscreen after launch; Zenny and Fuzzby share the far-bank comic aftermath.
storyIntentApproved.relationshipPowerDynamic: Keen caused the mess but hides; Zenny quietly holds moral/comic authority; Fuzzby's laughter supplies temptation.
storyIntentApproved.touchOrAvoidance: Only the berry touches Zenny; no character touches Zenny, her leaf or the honeycomb after the launch in this unit.
storyIntentApproved.eyelineRule: Zenny's attention can check Fuzzby and the aftermath, but she does not wink or address camera yet.
storyIntentApproved.silhouetteRead: Projectile speed resolves into Zenny's still seated silhouette with a small visible mark.
storyIntentApproved.silenceRule: Protect a quiet settling beat after Zenny's line as the laughter tapers.
storyIntentApproved.scoreInstruction: Keep music light and restrained, staying under dialogue and not pushing emotion.

cinematographyContractApproved.emotionalDistanceStart: Playful distance: we watch Keen's clever setup from the wide geography.
cinematographyContractApproved.emotionalDistanceEnd: Intimate restraint: we stay close enough to read Zenny's small control without making her overreact.
cinematographyContractApproved.revealStrategy: Reveal the wrong target through the berry's real travel, then hold the consequence instead of replaying it.
cinematographyContractApproved.shotScale: Wide opening, medium Fuzzby, readable relationship two-shot, medium Fuzzby and final Zenny reaction.
cinematographyContractApproved.lensIntent: Let the creek feel long at launch, then compress gently around Zenny's stillness after impact.
cinematographyContractApproved.cameraHeight: Starts at readable playground height near the bank, then travels at berry height before settling at Zenny's seated leaf level.
cinematographyContractApproved.composition: Preserve world positions and canonical size through motivated cuts; Fuzzby is not relegated to an unreadable background during his gag.
cinematographyContractApproved.depthStrategy: Depth carries story: near-bank machine, creek crossing, far-bank leaf and far-tree comb remain separated.
cinematographyContractApproved.cameraBehavior: Follow berry into splat, then make Fuzzby’s dream wake, press-ups and laughter visually dominant; show both during Zenny’s approved line, return to Fuzzby for suppression and relapse, land on Zenny’s restraint.

performanceContractApproved.playableIntention: Keen wants his clever plan to work without being caught; Zenny wants to keep ownership of her calm; Fuzzby turns the accident into delighted shared comedy before noticing any consequence.

phases.observableAction: Keen lines up the loaded catapult from the near bank, commits to the release, then immediately drops low beside the empty cup as the berry leaves him behind.
The oversized blueberry travels across the creek and makes one direct forehead contact, creating one visible splat and residual berry mark on Zenny.
Fuzzby wakes on the whole hanging comb and laughs with chest, head, wings and antennae all bouncing in uneven bursts while remaining supported by the comb.
Zenny opens her eyes, registers Fuzzby, licks away juice with measured control, then returns to a still seated pose with the berry mark still visible.

performanceContractApproved.physicalCauseAndEffect: One release empties the catapult cup; the berry’s flight ends in one forehead splat on Zenny; the impact and Fuzzby’s laughter draw Zenny out of meditation, but her controlled cleanup restores stillness without removing the mark.
performanceContractApproved.visibleEmotionalTurn: The visible change is from Keen’s careful confidence to hiding, and from Zenny’s meditation to marked awareness, then back to chosen composure.
performanceContractApproved.requiredLanding: End held on Zenny on her original leaf, calm again with the residual berry mark; Fuzzby remains on the whole hanging comb; Keen stays offscreen by the empty machine with empty paws.
performanceContractApproved.performanceFreedom: Allow small variations in Keen’s duck, Fuzzby’s laugh rhythm, wing flutter and Zenny’s micro-blinks, provided there is only one launch, one splat, no grab, and Zenny’s recovery stays restrained.

characterTruths.canonTrait: Scene contract trait: over-careful confidence under pressure becomes evasive self-protection when his plan misfires.
characterTruths.playableWant: Make the catapult plan succeed and avoid owning the visible mess.
characterTruths.pressureResponse: He commits sharply to the launch, then hides as soon as the berry is beyond his control.

characterTruths.substitutionTest: Fuzzby would overplay the miss physically and Zenny would not initiate the prank; only Keen’s careful-to-evasive behavior makes the empty machine feel like his responsibility.

characterTruths.canonTrait: The proud, full-throttle laughter maker commits 100% with body-first exuberance and warm chaos.
characterTruths.playableWant: Enjoy the ridiculous accident out loud with his whole body.
characterTruths.pressureResponse: He wakes into uncontrolled laughter rather than measured observation.
characterTruths.observableSignature: Bouncing chest, lively wings, antennae reacting, spectacles kept present, laughter energy uneven and exuberant on the comb.
characterTruths.substitutionTest: Zenny’s register is dry stillness and Keen is hiding; only Fuzzby can make the accident public through warm, manic physical laughter.

characterTruths.canonTrait: Still, dry counterweight to Fuzzby’s chaos; her restraint is active, not blank.
characterTruths.playableWant: Keep possession of her calm without pretending the disruption did not happen.
characterTruths.pressureResponse: She processes the hit with tiny controlled reactions instead of escalation.
characterTruths.observableSignature: Small eye reaction, precise attention shift, measured lick, seated reset with the mark retained.
characterTruths.substitutionTest: Keen would cover failure and Fuzzby would amplify it; only Zenny can make the punchline land through disciplined stillness.

performanceBudgetApproved.rationale: 20 seconds funds startled wake, dream press-ups, discovery, laughter, approved line and second laugh.

decisions.animationTimingApproved: At the splat Fuzzby jolts awake as if still dreaming, makes wordless sleepy mumbling SFX and performs two frantic little press-ups on the honeycomb (4-8s). He stops, looks down at Zenny, registers the berry mark and erupts into exaggerated whole-body laughter (8-11s). He keeps laughing beneath Zenny’s exact approved line (11-15.68s), then clamps his mouth shut with puffed cheeks and shaking shoulders, briefly contains it and bursts out laughing again (15.68-19s). Land on Zenny composed and Fuzzby recovering (19-20s). Keep canonical size and perch; no extra intelligible words.

inputs.ambitionBrief:
Julian explicitly requests rebuilding Scene 1 through the CURRENT shared directing workflow and refiring exactly TWO production clips, retaining the existing approved Buzzing Nook scene plate and approved S1.SH1 opening keyframe. This is a scoped new candidate revision, not approval of returned media. Existing successful work and every other scene remain preserved.

Author scene coverage before provider allocation. Two distinct clip jobs: S1.SH1 approximately 12 seconds and S1.SH2 approximately 26 seconds, with multiple motivated camera views inside each as needed. Do not force this back into one 30-second clip or treat a keyframe as an unchanging camera. Their combined scene is approximately 38 seconds. These durations preserve the existing approved performances and give physical comedy recovery time. The exact copied audio samples are retained; do not invent/reperform dialogue.

SOURCE OPENING for S1.SH1: /Users/julianjenkins/Desktop/Ai Studio/engine/media/shots/Ep3_S1.SH1_keyframe_candidate_e867481d.png. SCENE PLATE: /Users/julianjenkins/Desktop/Ai Studio/engine/media/Ep3_S1_plate_candidate_c66c0c33.jpeg. Start on that exact wide frame, not a blueberry close-up. Keen and his loaded catapult occupy the near bank foreground. Zenny sits on her established distant leaf on the far bank. Fuzzby starts asleep on the whole removable hanging honeycomb at the far tree. The berry crosses the real distance between banks. Only the camera changes screen projection; do not shift characters or landmarks to compress the journey.

S1.SH1: Keen launches ONE oversized blueberry. Preserve the enjoyable camera tracking beside/with the blueberry across the creek; Keen and the catapult stay at their original near-bank position BEHIND the travelling camera and do not reappear beside the flying berry. First contact on Zenny's forehead causes ONE splat: no overshoot, return or replay. Keen ducks beside his machine. The cup becomes and stays empty. Fuzzby wakes, reacts and laughs exuberantly on the honeycomb. His wings remain alive where flying/hovering; a supported seated pose need not fake hovering. His laughter is expressly authorised Seedance character SFX and continues underneath Zenny's spoken response, mixed below the words, then tapers. Exact Zenny line at 5.00–9.68s: “OK, Fuzzby, calm down. It’s not that funny.” Her restraint should be active, knowing composure: attention, small eye reaction, lick juice, quiet settling. No wink yet. End held on Zenny on her same leaf; keep the residual berry mark. Offscreen Keen remains by the empty catapult, paws empty; Fuzzby still on the whole hanging comb. No grab in clip one.

S1.SH2: a deliberate same-moment CUT to a new readable angle. The literal final frame of newly rendered S1.SH1 supplies dynamic continuity; it is not the new opening composition or a motion relay. The new opening must match Zenny's ACTUAL residual berry mark and leaf pose; use the current empty catapult turnaround, never the loaded-prop image for this clip. Do not impose a guessed forehead/cheek mark before inspecting the actual ending.

0–6s: Keen sees Fuzzby distracted and makes his opportunistic grab. Establish the route PAST Zenny with visible clearance; he never hits her, her leaf or its support. He successfully takes the WHOLE removable honeycomb from the branch. Fuzzby alone loses his perch, catches himself using his wings, fixes his attention on Keen and becomes a small drone-like pursuer. No Zenny falling or flying, no giant Fuzzby, no honey-house stealing.
6–10s: Fuzzby pursues Keen back across the same geography with continuous fast wings. Keen glances back, recognises the pursuit and says exact “Uh-oh—” at 8.00–9.24s, then escapes toward his near-bank machine carrying the whole comb. He passes clear of Zenny again.
10–15s: a readable side/contact view shows Keen's tail snag the still-tensioned EMPTY catapult arm/cord as he passes close, releasing the arm against his tail at exact “Ow!” 12.00–13.40s. One physical cause, one contact. His recoil lets the comb go; it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby on the near bank. Keep the cup visibly empty throughout; no reload, berry, blue wool ball, or magical reset.
15–22.20s: let Fuzzby notice the prize and direct a dry, satisfied “Nice machine.” at 18.00–19.56s toward Keen. Motivate a reverse for Keen's attempt to retain dignity: “It almost worked.” at 20.00–22.20s. Only the named speaker articulates dialogue. Listeners register the thought, not vacant stares. After the exchange the damaged machine tips/collapses as the final mechanical button; no explosion or disintegration.
22.20–26s: cut to Zenny on the ORIGINAL leaf, same residual berry mark and geography. She registers the aftermath, turns a small knowing look toward camera, gives ONE clearly readable wink, closes both eyes and returns to peaceful meditation. Protect a quiet hold after the wink. Do not overfill the ending with another gag or speech.

Cast and physical scale are from the current canonical Keen, Zenny and Fuzzby identity plates and registry, never an invented extra bee. Props and every reference have one role with stated exclusions. Build typed world-space staging, cast action ownership, active listening, stateChanges, sound ownership, motivated views and camera/cut reasons. Give each clip's opening a physically playable staging state. Separate approved Audio1 words/voice/cadence from expressly authorised Fuzzby laughter SFX, woodland ambience and physical Foley. Keep music restrained and scene-coherent; resolve softly for the last Zenny hold without cutting or changing speech.

Do not rewrite the five spoken lines or their occurrence ownership. Plan timings from the above existing approved sample placements. Do not treat old rejected trial prompts or contradictory storyboard captions as authority. All new SEE/HEAR/WATCH briefs must derive from this current scene plan, not a separately improvised description. Save a candidate with actual role execution/provenance for normal Studio handover. No additional provider clips or unrequested creative alternatives.

source.scope: Official Dreamina/BytePlus prompt guidance; executable API schema, pricing and account access are separate

guideSemantics.timestampControl: Time ranges allocate pacing and exact time points improve alignment; they are not a frame-accurate edit guarantee.
guideSemantics.extensionPreservation: Preserve the source and match its boundary state, but review the join; generated continuation and boundary frames are not guaranteed pixel-identical.
guideSemantics.negativeInstructions: Explicit forbidden items improve reliability but remain probabilistic and require review.
guideSemantics.identityStability: Multi-character consistency is improved, not self-approving; identity and count still require visual review.
guideSemantics.longVideoRoute: The 5-180 second mode is a Dreamina beta product capability, not a qualified Studio API route.
guideSemantics.audioOnly: Dreamina product guidance describes audio-only creation; the current BytePlus Seedance 2.0 API still requires at least one image or video reference.
guideSemantics.cleanOutput: Dreamina advertises cleaner 4K output; the executable provider contract remains the authority for resolution and every render still requires QC.
guideSemantics.watermarkPolicy: The Studio never uses generative watermark removal as a production shortcut; source footage must be owned or licensed and delivered clean.

The damaged machine tips later, after the dialogue exchange.

specialist.landingBreath: Let Zenny's wink register, then hold the peaceful reset briefly so the scene lands on calm rather than a new gag.

Performance phases: anticipation: Keen Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank; action: Fuzzby When the comb is removed, Fuzzby drops from the lost perch, catches himself with fast irregular wings, fixes on Keen and pursues across the same route; reaction: Keen Keen glances back, tightens into panic, passes too close to the empty catapult, recoils from one tail contact, and loses the comb as it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby; settle: Zenny After the near-bank aftermath and soft machine collapse, Zenny turns from the offscreen result toward camera, gives one clear wink, closes both eyes and resumes meditation on the original leaf. Cause and effect: Keen’s removal of the whole comb takes away Fuzzby’s support, causing Fuzzby to catch himself and pursue. Keen’s return path brings his tail into the still-tensioned empty arm or cord; one release snaps his tail, his recoil releases the comb, and the comb’s weight carries it through a bounce and roll to Fuzzby. The damaged empty machine later tips down softly after the exchange. Visible turn: Keen visibly shifts from sneaky opportunity to chased panic to embarrassed dignity; Fuzzby shifts from displaced pursuit to satisfied possession; Zenny shifts from watchful stillness to a single knowing acknowledgement. Land on: End on Zenny alone on the original leaf, residual berry mark matched from S1.SH1, both eyes closed after one wink; near-bank consequences remain true offscreen: Fuzzby has the whole comb and Keen is beside the collapsed empty machine. Acting freedom: Allow chase cadence, wing jitter, comb bounce spacing, Keen’s recovery posture and listener micro-reactions to vary, but preserve clear Zenny clearance, whole-comb ownership, empty-cup visibility, one tail contact, one machine collapse and one final wink.

Do not force this back into one 30-second clip or treat a keyframe as an unchanging camera. Their combined scene is approximately 38 seconds. Only the camera changes screen projection; do not shift characters or landmarks to compress the journey.

Preserve the enjoyable camera tracking beside/with the blueberry across the creek; Keen and the catapult stay at their original near-bank position BEHIND the travelling camera and do not reappear beside the flying berry. First contact on Zenny's forehead causes ONE splat: no overshoot, return or replay. Keen ducks beside his machine. The cup becomes and stays empty. Fuzzby wakes, reacts and laughs exuberantly on the honeycomb. His wings remain alive where flying/hovering; a supported seated pose need not fake hovering. His laughter is expressly authorised Seedance character SFX and continues underneath Zenny's spoken response, mixed below the words, then tapers. Exact Zenny line at 5.00–9.68s: “OK, Fuzzby, calm down. It’s not that funny.” Her restraint should be active, knowing composure: attention, small eye reaction, lick juice, quiet settling. providerPromptCompilation.sourcePrompt:
[Audience Purpose]
Story beat: Keen's opportunistic theft collapses into a self-earned slapback, then Zenny silently claims the final meaning.
Audience before: The audience sees a gap opening and suspects Keen may get away with it.
Audience after: The audience sees the prize recovered, Keen undercut by his own machine, and Zenny calmly close the scene.

[One-Sentence Summary]
Keen steals the whole comb, gets punished by his own empty catapult, and Zenny ends the scene with one calm wink.

[Camera Consciousness]
Dramatic owner: Keen.
Emotional action: He notices opportunity inside a mistake and commits to the route before the chase tightens.
Camera state: controlled.
Viewpoint: Cross-bank opener from the near bank looking toward the far-tree comb and Zenny's fixed leaf.
Lens family: Wide establishing with proof-friendly depth.
Movement trigger: Hold by design until Keen's decision to move becomes readable.
Movement finish: No decorative move in the opening frame; it holds as a complete starting beat.
Focus plan: Keep Keen, Zenny, the far-tree honeycomb, and the empty catapult all readable in one frame.
Exit condition: Exit when the audience clearly reads the geography and Keen's intent to move past Zenny toward the comb.

[CHARACTER ROLE INTEGRITY]

character:Zenny = @图3 (CB_Zenny.jpeg): round glasses; small dark nose; long eyelashes; rosy blush cheeks; smaller 12-inch bee proportions.
character:Fuzzby = @图4 (CB_Fuzzby.jpeg): bulbous tan nose; round wire-frame spectacles; larger 14-inch bee proportions.
Keep each named identity with its assigned action, voice, prop and ending; do not swap characters.

[Shot Sequence]

Subjects: Zenny from @图3; Fuzzby from @图4; Keen from @图5.
Action: Keen @图5 notices his miss, then chooses to steal the honeycomb while Fuzzby @图4 laughs atop it. Zenny @图3 stays still on her distant leaf.

shot.purpose: Complete the opportunistic grab, chase, tail-snag slapback, social aftermath and final Zenny wink in the second requested production clip.
shot.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: Keen Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank; action: Fuzzby When the comb is removed, Fuzzby drops from the lost perch, catches himself with fast irregular wings, fixes on Keen and pursues across the same route; reaction: Keen Keen glances back, tightens into panic, passes too close to the empty catapult, recoils from one tail contact, and loses the comb as it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby; settle: Zenny After the near-bank aftermath and soft machine collapse, Zenny turns from the offscreen result toward camera, gives one clear wink, closes both eyes and resumes meditation on the original leaf. Cause and effect: Keen’s removal of the whole comb takes away Fuzzby’s support, causing Fuzzby to catch himself and pursue. Keen’s return path brings his tail into the still-tensioned empty arm or cord; one release snaps his tail, his recoil releases the comb, and the comb’s weight carries it through a bounce and roll to Fuzzby. The damaged empty machine later tips down softly after the exchange. Visible turn: Keen visibly shifts from sneaky opportunity to chased panic to embarrassed dignity; Fuzzby shifts from displaced pursuit to satisfied possession; Zenny shifts from watchful stillness to a single knowing acknowledgement. Land on: End on Zenny alone on the original leaf, residual berry mark matched from S1.SH1, both eyes closed after one wink; near-bank consequences remain true offscreen: Fuzzby has the whole comb and Keen is beside the collapsed empty machine. Acting freedom: Allow chase cadence, wing jitter, comb bounce spacing, Keen’s recovery posture and listener micro-reactions to vary, but preserve clear Zenny clearance, whole-comb ownership, empty-cup visibility, one tail contact, one machine collapse and one final wink.

[One-Sentence Summary]
Keen steals the whole comb, gets punished by his own empty catapult, and Zenny ends the scene with one calm wink.

rejections.promptText:
[Audience Purpose]
Story beat: Keen's opportunistic theft collapses into a self-earned slapback, then Zenny silently claims the final meaning.
Audience before: The audience sees a gap opening and suspects Keen may get away with it.
Audience after: The audience sees the prize recovered, Keen undercut by his own machine, and Zenny calmly close the scene.

[One-Sentence Summary]
Keen steals the whole comb, gets punished by his own empty catapult, and Zenny ends the scene with one calm wink.

[Camera Consciousness]
Dramatic owner: Keen.
Emotional action: He notices opportunity inside a mistake and commits to the route before the chase tightens.
Camera state: controlled.
Viewpoint: Cross-bank opener from the near bank looking toward the far-tree comb and Zenny's fixed leaf.
Lens family: Wide establishing with proof-friendly depth.
Movement trigger: Hold by design until Keen's decision to move becomes readable.
Movement finish: No decorative move in the opening frame; it holds as a complete starting beat.
Focus plan: Keep Keen, Zenny, the far-tree honeycomb, and the empty catapult all readable in one frame.
Exit condition: Exit when the audience clearly reads the geography and Keen's intent to move past Zenny toward the comb.

[Shot Sequence]
Shot 1: 0–2.5s
Camera: Start on the exact approved @图1 composition. Hold the wide view until Keen notices the opportunity; the following edit takes us to his route.
Subjects: Zenny from @图3; Fuzzby from @图4; Keen from @图5.
Action: Keen stands shocked beside his already-fired empty catapult. His eyes find the laughing Fuzzby on the hanging honeycomb; his guilty surprise turns into a furtive plan. He shifts his weight to begin sneaking toward the far tree.
Performance: Keen thinks before moving: a guilty look at Zenny, a glance at the prize, then a small determined breath. Fuzzby remains laugh-distracted on his perch; Zenny stays composed on her leaf.
Setting / light / materials: Preserve the opening morning light, creek depth and near/far banks. Keep the upright empty catapult near Keen, the whole exposed-cell honeycomb at the far tree and Zenny below it on her original leaf.
End state: Keen has decided to steal the comb and begins his departure on two feet; the single comb is still hanging with Fuzzby on it.

Shot 2: 2.5–6s
Camera: a ground-level three-quarter full-body view along the established crossing toward the far tree. Track Keen on that route, then settle so both his paws and the branch attachment are visible for the grab.
Cut to the planned view. Preserve world positions, eyelines, action phase and story time across this edit.
Subjects: Zenny from @图3; Fuzzby from @图4; Keen from @图5.
Action: Keen tiptoes upright on two feet past Zenny with clear physical separation; she stays on her leaf and he never collides with her. Keen takes the whole removable honeycomb from the far-tree branch, causing Fuzzby alone to lose his perch. Show the attachment release by 5.5s, the entire original comb held in Keen's paws and empty air beneath the now-bare branch. Fuzzby drops a short distance, catches himself with his own wings and fixes on Keen.
Performance: Small quick tiptoe steps, short stable legs and compact bear proportions; no unfolding or stretching limbs. Keen's cautious triumph changes to alarm as the tiny bee Fuzzby catches himself, offended and ready to pursue. Fuzzby keeps his own round body, spectacles and insect wings throughout the grab.
Setting / light / materials: Use the same creek crossing and far-tree positions. The stolen prop retains the exact golden exposed hexagonal cells, outline and size of @图1; the tree architecture is separate and remains fixed.
End state: The branch is empty. Keen holds the complete detached original comb; Fuzzby is airborne under his own wings. Zenny is untouched on her original leaf.

Shot 3: 6–10s
Camera: a lateral tracking view of the return along the same crossing toward the near-bank catapult. Ease the camera to a stop with Keen, keeping his face and the pursuing Fuzzby readable.
Cut to the planned view. Preserve world positions, eyelines, action phase and story time across this edit.
Subjects: Zenny from @图3; Fuzzby from @图4; Keen from @图5.
Action: Fuzzby pursues Keen across the creek, causing Keen to glance back and realize he is being chased. Keen runs upright carrying the same comb, and Fuzzby pursues with tight drone-like flight on fast wings. By 7.8s Keen brakes beside the machine, plants both feet and looks back; he is stationary for the entire 8.00–9.24s dialogue interval. After the line he cautiously backs toward the machine; the tail has not contacted it yet.
Performance: The chase is nimble and comic. Keen's short legs stay proportionate through each stride; his eyes widen when he stops and sees Fuzzby closing in. Fuzzby stays a small bee, never becoming a bird or another character.
Setting / light / materials: The catapult is on the same near bank and remains upright and empty. Keen carries the one detached honeycomb continuously. Zenny and her leaf remain outside the chase lane.
End state: Keen is upright, stopped beside the near-bank machine with the comb still in his paws. Fuzzby is close behind; the tail contact is still ahead.
Spoken action: Keen, Keen is planted and looking back. Match the approved Audio1 performance exactly; no running during this line: {Uh-oh—}

Shot 4: 10–15s
Camera: a near-bank side view encompassing Keen, the empty arm and cord, his tail and the honeycomb landing area. Keep the single cause and contact visible before following the comb down.
Cut to the planned view. Preserve world positions, eyelines, action phase and story time across this edit.
Subjects: Fuzzby from @图4; Keen from @图5.
Action: Keen's tail snags the still-tensioned empty catapult arm/cord, causing one tail slap and the comb to drop, bounce and roll to Fuzzby. Keen backs into reach; the cord catches his tail at 11.75s and releases the arm for one contact at 12.00s, aligned with the approved exclamation. His startled recoil releases the comb. The same whole comb makes one short bounce and rolls to a stop on the near-bank ground by 14.6s. Fuzzby alights on that landed comb.
Performance: Keen briefly compresses with the surprise, then recovers his balance without changing his anatomy. Fuzzby follows the actual falling prize with his gaze before settling onto it. Let the bounce and roll read clearly after the impact.
Setting / light / materials: The throwing cup stays empty. The damaged machine remains standing for the later exchange. Retain the comb’s exposed hexagonal cells and original silhouette as it moves; no smooth spiral hive, replacement comb or duplicate on the far tree.
End state: Fuzzby sits on the original comb resting on the near-bank ground beside Keen and the damaged standing machine. The old far-tree branch remains empty.
Spoken action: Keen, Keen’s single tail recoil coincides with the original Audio1 onset at 12.00s. Preserve that exact vocal performance: {Ow!}
Hold: 2.0s — Hold the comb's bounce/roll to Fuzzby long enough for the audience to see the machine returned the prize.

Shot 5: 15–23.4s
Camera: a near-bank medium two-shot with Fuzzby on the landed comb, Keen beside him and the still-standing empty machine behind Keen. Hold their relationship and mouths legibly through both lines.
Cut to the planned view. Preserve world positions, eyelines, action phase and story time across this edit.
Subjects: Fuzzby from @图4; Keen from @图5.
Action: Fuzzby looks from the machine to Keen and delivers his dry observation while seated on the landed comb. Keen, stationary beside him, gathers his dignity and replies. The damaged empty machine tips/collapses after Keen's line, causing his cover-up to fail visibly. It remains upright through 22.20s, then tips and folds softly between 22.25 and 23.25s; Keen deflates as its clatter answers him.
Performance: Fuzzby underplays the satisfaction and listens without speaking over Keen. Keen attempts a sincere, defensive smile that fails as the prop goes down. Both speakers are visibly present, with readable eyelines toward one another; only the named speaker articulates.
Setting / light / materials: This is the near-bank landing location, not the far tree. The same comb remains on the ground beneath Fuzzby. The original empty machine retains its materials and only changes from damaged-standing to collapsed.
End state: The empty machine is collapsed beside the embarrassed Keen. Fuzzby stays on the one landed honeycomb at the near bank; neither returns to the old branch.
Spoken action: Fuzzby, Fuzzby stays seated on the near-bank comb and matches his exact approved Audio1 line: {Nice machine.}
Spoken action: Keen, Keen stands still, addressing Fuzzby. Keep the approved cadence and timing; the collapse follows the end of the line: {It almost worked.}

Shot 6: 23.4–26s
Camera: Cut at 23.4s to a gentle close-up of Zenny on her original leaf. Frame her face and leaf against soft foliage; exclude the old honeycomb perch and the other characters. Hold the camera.
Cut to the planned view. Preserve world positions, eyelines, action phase and story time across this edit.
Subjects: Zenny from @图3.
Action: Zenny gives one clear wink, then closes both eyes and returns to meditation. She acknowledges the offscreen clatter, looks toward camera, gives the one knowing wink at about 24.35s and a small warm closed-mouth smile at 24.6s. By 25.15s both eyes are closed again; sustain her peaceful meditation to the end.
Performance: Her warmth makes the final judgment affectionate, never smug. Make the wink an unmistakable single-eye closure, let the smile register, then let the breath and shoulders settle naturally into meditation.
Setting / light / materials: Retain the original leaf, far-bank light, round glasses and residual berry mark from the approved opening/current-state reference. A face identity sheet does not erase the mark. Offscreen, the honeycomb remains landed on the near bank and its old branch is still empty.
End state: Zenny meditates peacefully on the same leaf, both eyes closed, with the berry mark still visible and a trace of the warm smile. No further joke or action follows.
Hold: 1.4s — Protect the silence after the wink so the scene ends on composure, not another gag.

Witness staging: Keen clears past Zenny on the route to the comb; Zenny never gets touched. Fuzzby loses the perch only when the whole comb is removed; the support then reads empty. Zenny remains the still far-bank witness and final judge. Preserve each witness’s authored attention and reaction. Use stillness only where directed; do not freeze an active reaction or laughter cue.

[ACTION OWNERSHIP]
Keen owns the route, the whole-comb grab, and the tail recoil.
Fuzzby owns the perch loss, the pursuit, and the recovered comb.
Zenny owns the final judgment and reset.

Performance: Keen @图5 checks, commits. Fuzzby @图4's surprise becomes offended pursuit.
Setting / light / materials: Zenny @图3 is only a static distant witness if visible.
End state: Keen @图5 carries the intact comb; Fuzzby @图4 is airborne; branch empty.
Keep identities and actions distinct.

Cut to this view.

Keep identities and actions distinct.

Shot 5: 15–23.4s
Visible cast: Keen @图5; Fuzzby @图4 only.
Camera: Continuous near-bank two-shot; gently reframe between Fuzzby @图4 and Keen @图5, preserving eyelines.
Cut to this view.
Action: Fuzzby @图4 addresses Keen @图5 from the landed comb. Keen @图5 answers beside the empty upright machine. After his answer, the catapult collapses once softly at 22.25–23.25s.
Performance: Fuzzby @图4 underplays his appraisal. Keen @图5 gathers embarrassed dignity, then his shoulders sink. Listeners stay closed-mouth.

Cut to this view.

watchRetakeHistory.note: Preserve the successful chase, established creek geography, approved opening image, and exact approved 26-second Audio1 file and spoken words. Keen remains upright on two feet throughout this shot. Before the grab, he creeps toward the far-tree honeycomb on exaggerated careful tiptoes, with small lifted heels, a conspiratorial glance and paws free; no crawling, knuckle-walking, quadrupedal gait or movement on all fours. Preserve the current chase performance after the grab. The whole single comb visibly detaches before Fuzzby loses his perch; the original branch stays empty. The same comb travels with Keen, lands beside the near-bank empty catapult, and remains with Fuzzby there. In the final Zenny view preserve that changed world state: the old honeycomb must not reappear behind her. At the approved 12.00-second Ow cue, show the actual tail contact and recoil at the empty catapult; Keen must have reached the machine before this cue, rather than still running with the comb. Preserve all approved dialogue timings and lip-sync authority. Keep the machine standing through Keen's last line ending at 22.20 seconds; show the single collapse during 22.25–23.25, then cut to Zenny at 23.40. Zenny looks toward us, gives one unmistakable wink with one eye closed and the other visibly open, adds a warm knowing smile, then closes both eyes and settles back into meditation. Make the wink and smile readable within her final hold, not a simultaneous two-eye blink. Keep her residual berry mark, character identity and original leaf. These are bounded visual and acting corrections; do not regenerate audio, change dialogue, or approve any render.

Julian selects one full 26-second retake, with motivated internal cuts and the existing story, not a duration split. Preserve the exact approved opening keyframe and the approved 26-second HEAR file, all four spoken words, voices and measured timings unchanged. Treat these as visual execution corrections, not audio edits.
Opening: start on the actual approved wide frame for Keen's shocked reaction. Cut to a readable full-body side view when he moves: normal compact legs, stable blue-bear identity, upright bipedal tiptoes with small lifted heels and paws free. Show the established crossing route past Zenny with clearance, no contact with her. No stretched legs, hunch-shuffle or movement on all fours.
Theft: show the same single golden honeycomb from the approved opening, with the same irregular outline, size and exposed hexagonal cell surface. It is not a smooth striped spiral or conical beehive. Keen's paws close around it and visibly lift the whole comb free. The old branch is now empty. Fuzzby loses his perch only after this detachment, catches himself with his two wings and pursues. His face, glasses, rounded bee silhouette, wing and body proportions stay those of his own turnaround through every angle; no feathers or body redesign.
Chase: keep the lively small drone-like Fuzzby pursuit and the readable return path toward the near-bank empty catapult. Stage Keen's glance back and the 8.00–9.24 Uh-oh cue as a brief upright planted reaction, not speech while running. He brakes by the machine before the line, then makes the small backward movement that brings his tail to the still-live arm/cord. He must be there before the 12.00 Ow cue. Do not ask for a full creek crossing during either spoken interval.
Contact: at the 12.00–13.40 Ow cue, show the single tail contact and upright recoil with stable anatomy. The recoil releases the same hexagon-textured honeycomb from his paws; it bounces once and rolls to the waiting Fuzzby beside the near-bank machine. No flight into a new clearing or reset to the far tree. Keep the empty catapult upright until the final button.
Aftermath: Fuzzby owns the landed comb beside the near-bank machine, delivers Nice machine at 18.00–19.56, then Keen answers It almost worked at 20.00–22.20. Only the named speaker articulates; both are stationary for their exchange. Keep these existing audio performances verbatim. The empty machine tips/collapses once at 22.25–23.25.
Ending: cut at 23.40 to Zenny on her original leaf with the residual berry mark. Frame her face, leaf and nearby foliage only; exclude the distant original perch and the other characters/props from this final view. She gives one unmistakable one-eye-open wink, a small warm knowing smile, then closes both eyes and settles into meditation. The empty far-tree branch and landed near-bank comb remain true offscreen. Preserve existing non-dialogue sound policy. No new speech or new joke. Carry these corrections into the main typed shot actions, acting, camera and intended-state history; do not append a contradictory correction paragraph.

View 1:
Camera: Static wide; begin exactly on @图1.
Action: Keen notices his miss, then chooses to steal the honeycomb while Fuzzby laughs atop it. Zenny stays still on her distant leaf.
Performance: Keen's jaw closes; his eyes find opportunity before he moves.
Setting: Preserve creek distance, warm morning light and plush 3D CGI materials.
End state: Keen beside upright empty catapult; Fuzzby on hanging comb; Zenny on leaf.

View 2:
Camera: Track Keen full-body toward the far tree, then settle on his paws and the comb attachment.
Action: Keen tiptoes on two feet past Zenny with clear space, then takes the whole comb by 5.5s. Show the comb detaching, entirely in his paws, and the empty branch. Only then Fuzzby loses support, drops and catches himself with his wings.
Performance: Keen checks, commits. Fuzzby's surprise becomes offended pursuit.
Setting: Zenny is only a static distant witness if visible.
End state: Keen carries the intact comb; Fuzzby is airborne; branch empty.

View 3:
Camera: Track the return crossing laterally; stop at the near-bank catapult.
Action: Keen runs on two feet with the comb; Fuzzby pursues in drone-like flight. Keen plants both feet by 7.8s, stationary through 8.00–9.24s. After speaking he backs toward the machine; no contact yet.
Performance: Keen glances back, eyes widening; short legs stay proportionate. Fuzzby fixes on Keen, wings buzzing.
Setting: Preserve creek direction; machine upright and empty.
End state: Keen stopped with comb; Fuzzby closing.

View 4:
Camera: Side/contact view: tail, live cord/arm, empty cup, comb and receiving ground readable.
Action: At 11.75s Keen's tail catches the live cord/arm. One release at 12s causes one tail slap, recoil and comb release. The whole comb bounces once, rolls once, reaching Fuzzby by 14.6s.
Performance: Keen jolts with the pain cue; Fuzzby tracks the comb and settles on it.
Setting: Comb size unchanged; machine stays upright and empty.
End state: Fuzzby on the landed comb; Keen recovering, both near-bank.

View 5:
Camera: Continuous near-bank two-shot; gently reframe between Fuzzby and Keen, preserving eyelines.
Action: Fuzzby addresses Keen from the landed comb. Keen answers beside the empty upright machine. After his answer, the catapult collapses once softly at 22.25–23.25s.
Performance: Fuzzby underplays his appraisal. Keen gathers embarrassed dignity, then his shoulders sink. Listeners stay closed-mouth.
Setting: Keep the comb grounded here; nobody returns to the tree.
End state: Fuzzby retains the comb beside Keen and the collapsed empty machine.

View 6:
Camera: Fixed medium close-up of Zenny alone on her original leaf.
Action: Zenny looks toward camera. At 24.35s one eye closes in a clear wink while the other stays visibly open. At 24.6s she gives a warm closed-mouth smile. Both eyes close by 25.15s; meditate until 26s.
Performance: A deliberate wink, not a two-eye blink; amused, never speaking.
Setting: Match berry mark/light; surround Zenny with leaf and soft foliage.
End state: Zenny alone, mouth closed, eyes shut; berry mark visible.

seeActionReadiness.summary: The actual opening image supports the planned start state: Keen is foreground-left beside an upright empty catapult, Fuzzby is on the whole far-tree honeycomb, and Zenny is seated on her original far-bank leaf with the residual berry mark. This is suitable as an opener; future theft, pursuit, tail slap, comb roll, collapse and wink are intentions not proven by this still.
seeActionReadiness.camera: Wide cross-bank opener is readable and appropriate. It shows the near-bank catapult/Keen, the creek travel axis, the far-tree honeycomb/Fuzzby, and Zenny on the separate leaf in one establishing view.
seeActionReadiness.geography: Near bank, creek, far bank, Zenny’s leaf, and far-tree honeycomb are spatially clear. The route from Keen toward the far tree appears possible, with Zenny separated from the path and no visible contact with her leaf.
seeActionReadiness.pose: Keen reads upright/startled and empty-handed, looking toward the far-bank action. Fuzzby is supported atop the honeycomb and laughing/distracted. Zenny is seated calmly on the leaf with relaxed partially open eyes and closed mouth.
seeActionReadiness.propsEffects: The catapult is upright and visibly empty, with no visible tail interaction. The honeycomb appears whole and attached at the far tree. The catapult’s live internal tension cannot be visually proven in a still; that remains a declared starting intention, not observed mechanics.

before.purpose: Complete the opportunistic grab, chase, tail-snag slapback, social aftermath and final Zenny wink in the second requested production clip.
before.performanceAssignment: Performance phases: anticipation: Keen Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank; action: Fuzzby When the comb is removed, Fuzzby drops from the lost perch, catches himself with fast irregular wings, fixes on Keen and pursues across the same route; reaction: Keen Keen glances back, tightens into panic, passes too close to the empty catapult, recoils from one tail contact, and loses the comb as it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby; settle: Zenny After the near-bank aftermath and soft machine collapse, Zenny turns from the offscreen result toward camera, gives one clear wink, closes both eyes and resumes meditation on the original leaf. Cause and effect: Keen’s removal of the whole comb takes away Fuzzby’s support, causing Fuzzby to catch himself and pursue. Keen’s return path brings his tail into the still-tensioned empty arm or cord; one release snaps his tail, his recoil releases the comb, and the comb’s weight carries it through a bounce and roll to Fuzzby. The damaged empty machine later tips down softly after the exchange. Visible turn: Keen visibly shifts from sneaky opportunity to chased panic to embarrassed dignity; Fuzzby shifts from displaced pursuit to satisfied possession; Zenny shifts from watchful stillness to a single knowing acknowledgement. Land on: End on Zenny alone on the original leaf, residual berry mark matched from S1.SH1, both eyes closed after one wink; near-bank consequences remain true offscreen: Fuzzby has the whole comb and Keen is beside the collapsed empty machine. Acting freedom: Allow chase cadence, wing jitter, comb bounce spacing, Keen’s recovery posture and listener micro-reactions to vary, but preserve clear Zenny clearance, whole-comb ownership, empty-cup visibility, one tail contact, one machine collapse and one final wink.
before.camera: Open on a new matched cross-bank angle, show Keen pass Zenny cleanly to take the whole comb, Fuzzby pursue, Keen's tail snag the still-empty catapult once, the comb roll to Fuzzby, the near-bank dignity exchange with a soft machine collapse
before.openingPose: Open exactly on the approved wide keyframe: shocked Keen foreground left beside the empty catapult, Fuzzby laughing atop the far-tree honeycomb, Zenny marked on her original distant leaf. Preserve creek distance and all world positions. Keen first registers his mistake, then notices Fuzzby distracted, checks and decides to move.

characterTruths.canonTrait: Scene contract trait: over-careful confidence under pressure becomes opportunistic panic, then embarrassed dignity.
characterTruths.playableWant: Get the comb while Fuzzby is distracted, outrun the consequence, and then make the failure look almost respectable.
characterTruths.pressureResponse: He commits in sharp bursts, checks behind him when pursuit registers, recoils from the tail snap, then tries to reassemble his posture beside the ruined prop.
characterTruths.observableSignature: Quick clearance past Zenny, clutching the whole comb, backward glance, compressed tail-snap recoil, small dignity pose that fails against the collapsing machine.
characterTruths.substitutionTest: Fuzzby would perform bravado through noisy overcommitment and Zenny would not steal; only Keen’s careful opportunism makes the empty catapult’s slapback feel earned.

characterTruths.canonTrait: Body-first, full-throttle comedy bee whose energy is warm, manic and purposefully physical, never calm or mean.
characterTruths.playableWant: Recover the whole comb and turn the returned prize into social leverage without cruelty.
characterTruths.pressureResponse: Loss of perch becomes frantic wing recovery and fast offended pursuit, then satisfied possession when the comb returns.
characterTruths.observableSignature: Irregular buzzing catch, porpoising pursuit, attention locked on Keen, chest-forward possession of the comb once it rolls to him.
characterTruths.substitutionTest: Zenny’s comedy is stillness and Keen owns the failed scheme; only Fuzzby can convert laughter into buzzing pursuit and then into pleased ownership of the prize.

characterTruths.canonTrait: Still, dry counterweight to chaos; her smallest reaction can carry the judgement.

characterTruths.observableSignature: Unmoved seated silhouette, residual berry mark retained, small turn toward camera, single wink, both eyes closing into a hold.
characterTruths.substitutionTest: Keen’s reaction would be defensive and Fuzzby’s would be expansive; only Zenny can end the scene by making restraint itself the button.

phases.observableAction: Keen checks Fuzzby’s distraction, chooses the clear path past Zenny, reaches the far-tree branch, takes the whole removable comb and turns back toward the near bank.
When the comb is removed, Fuzzby drops from the lost perch, catches himself with fast irregular wings, fixes on Keen and pursues across the same route.
Keen glances back, tightens into panic, passes too close to the empty catapult, recoils from one tail contact, and loses the comb as it bounces and rolls to Fuzzby.
After the near-bank aftermath and soft machine collapse, Zenny turns from the offscreen result toward camera, gives one clear wink, closes both eyes and resumes meditation on the original leaf.

performanceContract.physicalCauseAndEffect: Keen’s removal of the whole comb takes away Fuzzby’s support, causing Fuzzby to catch himself and pursue. Keen’s return path brings his tail into the still-tensioned empty arm or cord; one release snaps his tail, his recoil releases the comb, and the comb’s weight carries it through a bounce and roll to Fuzzby. The damaged empty machine later tips down softly after the exchange.
performanceContract.visibleEmotionalTurn: Keen visibly shifts from sneaky opportunity to chased panic to embarrassed dignity; Fuzzby shifts from displaced pursuit to satisfied possession; Zenny shifts from watchful stillness to a single knowing acknowledgement.
performanceContract.requiredLanding: End on Zenny alone on the original leaf, residual berry mark matched from S1.SH1, both eyes closed after one wink; near-bank consequences remain true offscreen: Fuzzby has the whole comb and Keen is beside the collapsed empty machine.
performanceContract.performanceFreedom: Allow chase cadence, wing jitter, comb bounce spacing, Keen’s recovery posture and listener micro-reactions to vary, but preserve clear Zenny clearance, whole-comb ownership, empty-cup visibility, one tail contact, one machine collapse and one final wink.
